title: Monsanto pays Agent Orange veterans compensation

tellings.quote: In the mid1 1980s, Monsanto was required to pay millions in compensation to veterans of war who had been exposed to the highly toxic chemical

plain: In the mid 1980s, the chemical company Monsanto was made to pay millions of dollars to war veterans who had been exposed to Agent Orange, which Michels calls a highly toxic chemical. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the dark history of the drug and chemical industry, as an example of a company paying for harm it did to people.
